scheme.benefits:
**Rate of Scholarship**

- ₹12,000/-per annum at the Graduation level for the first three years of College and University courses.
- ₹20,000 per annum at the Post-graduation level.
- ₹20,000/-per annum in the 4th and 5th year to the Students pursuing professional courses, in case, where the duration of the course is five (5) years/Integrated course.
- Students pursuing technical courses such as B.Tech, B.Engg. will get scholarship up to graduation level only i.e. ₹12,000 p.a. for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year and ₹20,000 in the 4th year.

﻿
**Mode of Disbursal**
The scholarship will be disbursed directly into the Aadhar seeded bank accounts of the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
scheme.exclusions:
- Students who are pursuing correspondence or distance mode or pursuing Diploma courses are not eligible.
 - Students who are already availing the benefit from any other scholarship schemes including State-run scholarship schemes/ fee waiver & reimbursement schemes are not eligible.
scheme.eligibility:
- The applicant must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class 12th of 10+2 pattern or equivalent.
 - The applicant must be pursuing regular degree courses.
 - The applicant must be pursuing courses at colleges/ institutions recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education and the respective Regulatory Bodies concerned.
 - The gross parental/ family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹4,50,000/- per annum.
 - For renewal of scholarship in each year of study, besides getting at least 50% marks in the Annual Examination, maintenance of adequate attendance should be at least 75%.
 - The students are required to have Aadhaar seeded bank accounts opened in their name.

application_process.steps:
**One Time Registration (OTR)**
**Step 1:** Visit the National Scholarships Portal (NSP) One Time Registration page and Click on “Apply for OTR”
**Step 2:** Guidelines for OTR will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read carefully the undertaking. Accept the Terms. Click “Next”.
**Step 3:** Register your active mobile number in the OTR registration form. All correspondence/communication will be done on the submitted mobile/e-mail only. 
**Step 4:** Complete Aadhaar e-KYC by entering Parent/Legal Guardian/Student Aadhaar number. Submit the OTP received and Click “verify”
**Step 5:** Enter details on the next page and click “Finish”. You will receive a Reference Number. Download the NSP OTR App and the Aadhaar FaceRD App from Google Play Store and complete face authentication for generating OTR.
**Step 6:** On successful face authentication, your 14-digit OTR number will be generated and sent via SMS.

**Fresh Application**
**Step 1:** Visit the Applicant Login page of the National Scholarships Portal. Select “OTR Login” and enter your OTR number and password.
**Step 2:** Type the Captcha and click “Login”.
**Step 3:** On the next screen, provide the OTP received on your registered mobile number. You will be directed to the Password Reset screen. Create a new password and confirm.
**Step 4:** Click “Submit”. You will be directed to the “Applicant’s Dashboard”.
**Step 5:** On the left pane, click “Application Form”. The fields marked as * are compulsory. Fill in the details and upload the documents. The verification of credentials of the students (caste, educational qualifications etc.) will be done through the DIGILOCKER facility of the MeitY, Govt. of India. 
**Step 6:** You can either click on “Save as Draft” to complete the application later. Else, click “Final Submit” to apply.

**Track Payment Status**
The student can track their payment status from the template “Know Your Payment” in the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) Portal either by indicating their Aadhaar Number, Bank Account number or NSP Application ID.
**NOTE 1:** The National Scholarships Portal will provide the timelines for opening & closing of the portal.
**NOTE 2:** Online applications will be verified at two levels i.e. by the Institute, where the student is studying and thereafter by the concerned State Higher Education Department or any other Agency/ Official nominated by the State as State Nodal Agency (both for fresh and renewal applicants).
**NOTE 3:** Students will not be permanently debarred for scholarships due to delay in renewal or verification. However, students will have to submit renewal applications within a cut-off date. Renewal for that year will not be allowed if an applicant misses this deadline. However, students can apply for renewal in the following year if they meet the eligibility conditions.﻿

**Grievance Redressal**
In case of any grievances/complaints regarding the above scheme, the same may be registered to the following link: http://pgportal.gov.in/grievancenew.aspx other than to the Nodal Officer whose email is available on the NSP portal (Services Tab).

documents_required: The following documents need to be uploaded on the Portal at the time of application:
a. FRESH: 12th Mark Sheet, Family Income Certificate, Category/ caste Certification for reserved category students, Disability Certificate (if applicable)
b. RENEWAL: Previous Year Mark Sheet
_The copy of above-mentioned documents must be provided to the institutes at the time of verification, if sought for by the Institute Nodal Officer (INO)._

faqs.question: What is the methodology adopted for generating merit list for selecting the beneficiaries under the scheme?
faqs.answer: From the eligible applicants, merit list is drawn based on gender (50 boys: 50 girls), stream (3-Science: 1-Commerce: 3-Humanities), Category (SC-15 %, ST-7.5 % and OBC-27 %), and 5 % horizontal reservation is provided for students with Benchmark Disabilities (Disability of 40% or more) from the allocated slots of respective State Education Boards. In case of shortfall in the number of applications, the scholarship slots shall be interoperable among categories (Gen, OBC, SC & ST), gender (Female, Male) and State Quota to maximize use of slots for fresh scholarships with effect from academic year 2022-23, subject to the condition that guidelines of Ministry of Finance and NITI Aayog regarding SC/ST fund allocation of the schemes are adhered to.

faqs.question: What is the rate of scholarship under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The rate of scholarship is Rs. 12,000/- per annum at Graduation level for first three years of College and University courses and Rs. 20,000/- per annum at Post-Graduation level. Students pursuing technical courses are paid Rs. 20,000/- per annum in the 4th and 5th year. Students pursing B.Tech/ BE would get scholarship for 4 years only i.e Rs. 12000 per annum for first three years and Rs. 20,000 per annum in the 4th year.

faqs.question: What is the duration of scholarships and criteria for renewal under the scheme?
faqs.answer: A student will be eligible for the scholarship for a total duration not exceeding 5 years. A scholarship under the scheme is renewable on year-to-year basis up to Post Graduate level (except for the students pursuing technical courses leading to degree at graduation level). Student must secure at least 50% marks and maintain adequate attendance of at least 75%.

faqs.question: What is the methodology for disbursement of scholarship under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Scholarship is disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode i.e. directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiary. The scholarship amount will be disbursed in the Aadhaar Seeded Bank Account. To have seamless disbursal of scholarships, students are required to seed the Aadhaar with the bank account as mentioned in the application form. The student can track his/her payment status from the template “Know Your Payment” in the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) portal and can also check status on NSP with their login credentials. If the PFMS status is shown as “Success”, then the student is required to check the status of the bank account which was seeded with Aadhaar at the time of transaction.

faqs.question: What precautions are to be exercised while selecting the institution from the drop down menu?
faqs.answer: While selecting the course, where he/she is studying, if there are similar courses with difference in course duration, student need to ascertain that they are selecting the right course from their Institute Nodal Officers. If the duration of course is not selected appropriately, then the students will face error during Renewal of application.

faqs.question: What are the documents that are required to be uploaded for applying and verification?
faqs.answer:
The following documents need to be uploaded on the Portal at the time of application:
a. FRESH: 12th Mark Sheet, Family Income Certificate, Category/ caste Certification for reserved category students, Disability Certificate (if applicable)
b. RENEWAL: Previous Year Mark Sheet
The copy of above-mentioned documents must be provided to the institutes at the time of verification, if sought for by the Institute Nodal Officer (INO).

faqs.question: What is the UID number/ Aadhaar number?
faqs.answer: UID number otherwise known as ‘Aadhaar’ number is Unique Identification Number given by Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Aadhaar Number should be seeded with the Bank Account in which Scholarship Amount is desired to be transferred.

faqs.question: How should I check the status of my application online?
faqs.answer: You have to login under the option ‘Student Login’ by entering your Aadhaar number/ OTR number. After login, under the option ‘My Application’, you will be able to view the option ‘Check Your Status’ against your Application ID. Under this option you can check your online application status.

faqs.question: How do I know the name and address of nodal officers at my State Education Board/CBSE/ CISCE?
faqs.answer: The name and contact details of the Nodal Officer of the State Education Boards/CBSE/CISCE are available in the Nodal Officers (Scheme Wise) option available under the Public Corner on the home page of National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

faqs.question: Where to lodge complaints/ queries/ grievances regarding scholarship application?
faqs.answer: The grievances need to be register on the Grievance Registration Tab available in their Login. All the technical complaints regarding working of the portal/ processing of online application/ verification status, etc. may be addressed to the National Scholarship Portal. Grievances regarding “PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students” may be addressed to Department of Higher Education, MoE.

faqs.question: Can students who missed the renewal application deadline on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) still apply for renewal in subsequent years if they meet the eligibility conditions?
faqs.answer: Yes, students can apply for renewal in the following year if they meet the eligibility conditions.

faqs.question: How are the total number of scholarships distributed among the State Education Boards?
faqs.answer: The total number of scholarships are divided amongst the State Education Boards based on the State’s population in the age group of 18-25 years, after segregating share of CBSE and ICSE on the basis of number of students passing out from various Boards in the country.

faqs.question: How are students from reserved categories, weaker sections, and minorities eligible for reservation benefits in the context of the Central Reservation Policy
faqs.answer: Students belonging to reserved categories/weaker sections /minorities etc. are eligible to get benefit of reservation on the basis of merit, subject to Central Reservation Policy [i.e. 15% seats are earmarked for SCs, 7.5% for STs and 27 % for OBCs and 5% horizontal reservation for students with Benchmark Disabilities (Disability of 40% or more) in all the categories].

scheme.name: Social Security for Tea Plantation Workers in Assam
scheme.brief_description: The scheme aims to provide institutionalized social security cover, including provident funds, pensions, and life insurance. It provides monthly pensions, provident fund advances, and lump-sum death benefits to tea plantation workers in Assam and their dependent families.
scheme.details: The scheme "Social Security for Tea Plantation Workers in Assam" was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. The scheme aims to provide institutionalized social security cover, including provident funds, pensions, and deposit-linked insurance, to the tea garden workers and employees working in the state of Assam. The scheme provides provident fund advances, monthly family pensions, and one-time life assurance benefits. The applicant must be an employee of a tea plantation or a tea factory receiving a monthly salary up to ₹15,000/- per month or a daily wage worker. The scheme is implemented by the Assam Tea Employees Provident Fund Organization.
scheme.benefits:
##### ***Assam Tea Plantations Provident Fund Scheme***

- Provident Fund advances provided on grounds such as marriage, death ceremonies, medical treatment, higher/technical education, economic hardships, and house building.
- Settlement of a member's Provident Fund account upon retirement, termination, or cessation of employment.

##### ***Pension Scheme***

- Full pensionary benefit paid after retirement at the age of 58 years, provided the member has a minimum period of service of 10 years.
- In the event of cessation of membership after 50 years and before 58 years, pension benefits are paid as per a prescribed schedule.
- Family Pension-cum-Life Assurance Scheme:
- A lump-sum one-time benefit of ₹2,000/- is immediately paid on the death of the tea plantation worker.
- A minimum monthly family pension of ₹1,000/- per month is provided.
- A maximum monthly family pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided, depending on the Provident Fund balance of the member on the date of death.
- Timely disbursement of Family Pension claims is done within 7 days.

##### ***Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme***

- A one-time monetary assurance benefit is paid to the nominee in the event of the death of an employee who was a member of the Provident Fund Scheme.
- A minimum assurance benefit of ₹1,00,000/- (previously ₹50,000/-) is provided to the nominee.
- A maximum assurance benefit of ₹2,00,000/- (previously ₹1,00,000/-) is provided to the nominee, equal to the amount of balance in the deceased member's Provident Fund account.
- Timely disbursement of Deposit Linked Insurance claims is done within 7 days.

##### ***Conditions***

- _The employee must contribute 12% of their wages, which includes dearness allowances, value of food concessions, and amounts received for plucking tea leaves._
- _The employer must contribute at the same 12% rate._
- _The employer is mandated to deduct the contributions from the employee and deposit the collected amount along with their own share into the Board's Account within 30 days._
- _If an employer fails to deposit the contribution within the prescribed time, a loss of interest at 15% per annum is charged on the employer for the defaulting period._
- _For the Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme, contributions are made by the Tea Garden Management at 0.50% and the Government of India at 0.25% of the gross annual wages._
- _For the Family Pension-cum-Life Assurance Scheme, the Government of India contributes 1 1/6% of the gross annual wages of a tea plantation worker._
scheme.eligibility:
- The applicant must be an employee of a plantation or a tea factory in the state of Assam.
- The applicant must be receiving a monthly salary up to ₹15,000/- per month, or be a daily-wage worker.
- For full pensionary benefits, the member must retire at the age of 58 years with a minimum period of service of 10 years.
- For the Family Pension-cum-Life Assurance Scheme and the Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme, the member must expire while in service.
- For the Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme, the deceased employee must have a minimum Provident Fund balance of ₹1,000/- at credit on the date of death.

application_process.steps:
##### **Step 1:****** ***Accessing the e-Portal***
The employer or organization official must begin the process by accessing the [official portal](https://atepfo.in/Home) of ATEPFO. This portal acts as the centralized dashboard for all statutory submissions and online claims.
##### **Step 2:****** ***Employer and Member Registration***
The employer must navigate to the "Registration" section on the portal to execute "Employer Registration" for their tea garden or factory. Following this, the employer must perform "Member Registration" for all eligible employees and daily wage workers from the very first day of their employment.
##### **Step 3:****** ***Contribution Deduction and Deposit***
The employer must actively deduct 12% of the employees' wages and match the contribution with their own 12% share. The employer then logs into the "Employers Login" section and utilizes the "Quick Pay (Dues)" facility to deposit the funds into the Board's account within the mandatory 30-day window.
##### **Step 4:****** ***Claim Submission by Officials***
When a member requires an advance, reaches retirement, or in the event of a worker's death, the designated ATEPFO Officials log in directly from the tea gardens. They navigate to specific sections ("Provident Fund Login", "PENSION Login", "Deposit Linked Insurance Login") to process and submit the statutory claim forms.

##### ***Status Tracking***
The submitted claims and complaint registrations are processed live on the portal. Members can monitor the progress of their claims, payments, and complaints directly through the "Claim Status Check" facility, the "e-Passbook", or via the integrated SMS Gateway. 
##### ***Benefit Disbursal***
Upon successful verification, benefits such as family pensions or insurance assurances are disbursed to the beneficiary within 7 days.
##### ***Grievance Redressal / Help & Support***
Applicants and members can utilize the "Register a Complaint" and "Complaint Status" modules directly on the e-Portal. For further assistance, the official contact number is **0361-2300108**, and the support email address is **atppf@live.com**.

documents_required: Proof of Employment in a Tea Plantation or Tea Factory in Assam.
Salary Slip or Wage Proof Indicating a Monthly Salary up to ₹15,000/- or Daily Wage Status.
Death Certificate of the Employee (Required in Case of Claims for Family Pension and Deposit-Linked Insurance Schemes).
Nominee Identity Proof and Bank Account Details (Required for Death Claim Settlements).
Assam Tea Employees Provident Fund Organization Member Registration Details.

faqs.question: I am currently employed in a tea factory and I want to know the maximum monthly salary I can earn to still qualify for these workplace benefits?
faqs.answer: You must be receiving a monthly salary of up to ₹15,000/- or be working as a daily wage earner to qualify.

faqs.question: What are the specific age and service duration requirements I need to fulfill in order to receive my full retirement pensionary benefits when I stop working?
faqs.answer: You are entitled to full pensionary benefits if you retire at the age of 58 years and have completed a minimum of 10 years of service.

faqs.question: In the unfortunate event that I pass away while I am still actively employed, is there any immediate one-time financial assistance provided to my surviving family members?
faqs.answer: Yes, a lump-sum one-time benefit of ₹2,000/- is immediately paid to your family upon your death.

faqs.question: If I happen to expire during my service years, what is the exact range of the regular monthly financial support that my surviving spouse or children will receive?
faqs.answer: Your eligible family members will receive a monthly family pension ranging from a minimum of ₹1,000/- to a maximum of ₹1,500/-, depending on your Provident Fund balance at the time of your death.

faqs.question: Are there any specific personal emergencies or life events for which I am allowed to withdraw some money from my accumulated savings before my actual retirement?
faqs.answer: You can take advances for specific grounds such as marriage, death ceremonies, medical treatment, higher or technical education, economic hardships, and house building.

faqs.question: How much money will be deducted from my regular earnings every month to build up my savings, and what does this calculation include?
faqs.answer: You must contribute 12% of your wages, which includes your dearness allowances, the value of food concessions, and any amounts received for plucking tea leaves.

faqs.question: What happens if the management of my tea estate fails to deposit their required matching financial share into my account within the mandatory thirty-day time limit?
faqs.answer: If your employer fails to deposit the contribution within the prescribed time, a loss of interest at 15% per annum is charged on them for the defaulting period.

faqs.question: For my designated nominee to receive the one-time monetary assurance benefit if I die in service, is there a minimum balance I must maintain in my savings account?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must have a minimum balance of ₹1,000/- at credit in your Provident Fund account on the date of your death for your nominee to be eligible.

faqs.question: If I meet the minimum balance criteria and pass away while working, how is the exact amount of the one-time assurance benefit calculated for my nominee?
faqs.answer: Your nominee will receive an amount equal to the balance in your Provident Fund account, subject to a minimum of ₹1,00,000/- and a maximum of ₹2,00,000/-.

faqs.question: If my spouse is no longer alive, up to what specific age will my surviving children continue to receive the regular monthly financial support after my death?
faqs.answer: The benefit continues until the age of 18 years for a son, and until the age of 21 years for an unmarried daughter.

faqs.question: What happens to my post-retirement financial benefits if my membership ceases after I turn fifty years old but before I reach the standard retirement age of fifty-eight?
faqs.answer: In the event of cessation of membership between the ages of 50 and 58 years, your pension benefits will be paid according to a prescribed schedule.

faqs.question: As a newly hired daily wage worker in the plantation, how soon after my joining date do I become eligible to start receiving the provident fund benefits?
faqs.answer: You are eligible to become a member and are entitled to the Provident Fund benefits from the very first day of your work.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum number of years I need to be a member before my family becomes eligible to claim the regular monthly survivor's pension if I die?
faqs.answer: Yes, your family is eligible for the pension subject to your completion of at least one year of membership in the Provident Fund.

faqs.question: After my family successfully submits all the required statutory claim forms following my death, what is the expected maximum timeframe for the authorities to disburse the financial benefits?
faqs.answer: Upon successful verification, benefits such as family pensions or deposit-linked insurance claims are disbursed to the beneficiary within 7 days.

scheme.name: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship
scheme.department: Department Of Science & Technology, Government Of India
scheme.brief_description: The “WISE-SCOPE Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India with the aims to provide opportunity to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their S&T knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society.
scheme.details:
The “Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities (WISE-SCOPE) Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India to provide opportunities to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their Science & Technology knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society. This program promotes projects that directly deal with challenges at the grassroots level and address them through Science & Technology interventions. Projects under WISE-SCOPE (WISE-Societal Challenges with Opportunities) should provide Science & Technology solutions to our social problems, livelihood generation, drudgery reduction, health and nutrition-related issues, management of natural resources, sustainable agriculture, climate change, disaster management, etc.
The project proposal should include the development of viable technology/technique with the possibility of lab-to-land transfer, adaptation and scaling up for the benefit of society under the following identified broad thematic areas.

 1. Energy, Water and Waste Management (EWWM)
 1. Engineering and Technology Development (ETD)
 1. Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development (ECSD)
 1. Agriculture and Allied Sciences (AAS)
 1. Health, Food, and Nutrition (HFN)

> **Project Tenure:** 

The project tenure shall be up to 3 years.
scheme.benefits: - **Monthly Fellowship:** Eligible candidates will receive a fellowship amount of ₹55,000/- per month along with HRA as per norms. - **Research Grant:** Selected fellows will be provided a research grant of ₹2.00 Lakhs per year for project-related activities. - **Field Demonstration Support:** Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- will be provided for field demonstration during the project tenure. - **Equipment Assistance:** Support for the purchase of small equipment up to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- will be provided. - **Institutional Overhead Charges:** Institutional overhead charges will be given as per DST norms.
scheme.eligibility:
> **Employment:**

 - Candidates in regular employment are not eligible for WISE-SCOPE.

**Note 01:** The women scientists who are temporarily employed in research or academics may apply to this program but they have to leave earlier assignments, if, selected for the WISE-SCOPE program.
**Note 02:** The position of the applicant in any project, as Post-Doctoral Fellow, Research Associate, etc. will be considered a temporary assignment.
> **Age:**

 - The minimum age to apply is 27 years and the maximum is 60 years as of the date of submission.

> **Educational Qualification:**

 - Women Scientists who have completed a Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences or have equivalent degrees like MD/MS/MDS are eligible for the WISE-SCOPE fellowship.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The call is open for proposal submission under WISE-SCOPE at ePMS ([https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in)).
**Step 2:** The proposal format is available at [https://dst.gov.in](https://dst.gov.in), [https://onlinedst.gov.in](https://onlinedst.gov.in).
**Step 3:** Log on to [https://onlinedst.gov.in/](https://onlinedst.gov.in/) to access the home page of the “DST e-PMS Portal”.
**Step 4:** Click on “New PI Registration” and fill in the requisite details for New user registration. In the ‘Personal Information’ section, fill in- department, Institute, and Institute Address as per the Host Institute identified for the WISE-SCOPE Fellowship project. Fill in the Designation as ‘WISE-SCOPE Fellow’.
**Step 5:** After logging in, click on the “Submit proposals” link, which will take you to a page seeking information like – General information, Principal Investigator, Mentor detail, Suggested Referees (Those who are working and also experts in the proposed area), Financial Details, PFMS Details, Ongoing Project Details (if any), Programme details, then finally Submission. Fill in all the information sought against each menu, as applicable.
**Step 6:** Project detail under the Programme detail menu would require information about the category of the project. Please carefully choose the category of the project based on the objective and expected outcome of the proposed work. Need to mention the specific challenge of the society which is being addressed by this scientific proposal and also the target beneficiary which would be affected by its outcome.
**Step 7:** In the ‘Financial Details’ section, enter the ‘WISE-SCOPE Fellow’ in the description in each year of the fellowship section of the recurring budget section. The amount for each year is calculated based on ₹6,60,000/- per year (@₹55,000/- per month). If claiming for HRA, fill in the amount based on the applicable rate @ 9/ 18/ 27 % (as per GOI norms for X, Y and Z class of city) of the fellowship amount. Research grant is @ ₹2,00,000/- per year. In case of field testing, demonstration, or knowledge dissemination of the technology the max. limit of @ ₹1,00,000/- is allocated. Overhead would be as per norms. Non-recurring grant is up to max. ₹2,00,000/- for small equipment. In case of a request for more than one small equipment within the maximum limit, please fill names of each equipment with its cost in the desired year. Quotation of each equipment would require to be uploaded as a supporting document. Justification of all requirements (especially research grants, equipment etc.) should properly be filled.
**Step 8:** If you have the PFMS Unique Agency Code of the Host Institute, fill it in the ‘PFMS Details’; else, leave this section. It will be required later during the project amount release process, therefore keep this information ready later on accordingly, if not available now. 
**Step 9:** After filling in all the above particulars, preview all given details before the final submission of the application form by clicking on the “Preview” button. The preview page will display all the facts/ particulars that you have mentioned. If there is something that you wish to update, go back and correct the information or else proceed with the filled details by clicking on the “Submit” button to finally push data into the server.
**Step 10:** Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the FINAL SUBMIT BUTTON.
**Note 01:** It is mandatory to submit the proposals only through online mode. There is no need to submit the hard copy of the proposal at the DST. Proposal submitted through e-mail will not be entertained
**Note 02:** The PI is required to see the completeness of the application before it is finally submitted. The PI shall keep a copy of the submitted proposal for their reference. 
**Note 03:** In case more than one proposal is found submitted by the same PI, the last submitted proposal would be considered for evaluation.
**Note 04:** Incomplete or wrongly filled-up application format or application with a lack of essential information/ documents will be summarily rejected.
**Note 05:** Application format is available at the online portal [(https://onlinedst.gov.in/)]((https://onlinedst.gov.in/) given on the website ([https://dst.gov.in/](https://dst.gov.in/)). Submission of proposals other than in the prescribed format shall summarily be rejected without any further processing as per programme norms.
> **Last Date for Receipt of Application:**

• The online Application portal is open throughout the year for proposal submission.
• For any enquiry, please contact enquiry-wosdst@gov.in

scheme.name: Women Scientist Scheme-C
scheme.brief_description: A scheme by MoST for female candidates with a break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. 1-year training is provided in Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), patent search, know-how, drafting, filing, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright.
scheme.details: A scheme by MoST for female candidates with a break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. 1-year training is provided in Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), patent search, know-how, drafting, filing, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright, in association with various Knowledge Partners (i.e. Law firms, Knowledge Processing Organizations (KPOs), Companies, Government agencies, and so on). The scheme is being implemented by the Patent Facilitating Centre of Technology Information Forecasting & Assessment Council (TIFAC). Minimum essential qualifications are Master of Science; Bachelors in Engineering/Technology or equivalent. Proficiency in handling computerized databases, collection, collation, analysis, and report preparation is desirable.

scheme.name: Khelo India Scheme: Promotion of Inclusiveness through Sports
scheme.brief_description: The scheme aims to promote social inclusion, gender equality, peace, development, and participation in sports by supporting rural and indigenous games, sports for women, persons with disabilities, and youth in disturbed areas across the country.
scheme.details: The "Promotion of Inclusiveness through Sports" component of the "Khelo India Scheme" implemented by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, to promote social inclusion, gender equity, peace, and sports participation through targeted interventions for women, persons with disabilities, rural and indigenous communities, and youth in disturbed areas. The component recognizes the role of sports in community development, healthy lifestyles, and national integration. It operates through four sub-components: Sports for Peace and Development, Promotion of Rural and Indigenous/Tribal Games, Promotion of Sports among Persons with Disabilities, and Promotion of Sports among Women. Financial assistance, infrastructure support, competitions, training, coaching, scholarships, and promotional activities are provided under the component. The component is implemented in coordination with sports federations, government agencies, the Sports Authority of India, and other stakeholders.
scheme.benefits:
> **Sports for Peace and Development:**

- Support for sports competitions in terrorism, extremism-affected, disturbed, and border areas.
- Provision of coaches, sports equipment, consumables, and technical support.
- Boarding, lodging, and travel support for participants during competitions.
- Promotion of village-level sports competitions for youth engagement.
- Enhancement and utilization of sports infrastructure in eligible areas.

> **Promotion of Rural and Indigenous/Tribal Games:**

- Financial assistance for organizing national, state-level, and local competitions.
- Support for promotion of indigenous games such as Mallakhamb, Kalaripayattu, Gatka, Thang-Ta, and Silambam.
- Assistance for organizing demonstrations and awareness activities.
- Support through Ek Bharat Shrestha Bharat sports events.
- Opportunity for talented players to be selected as Khelo India Athletes.
- Establishment of Khelo India Centres for recognized indigenous games.
- Accreditation support for traditional academies and training centres.
- Development of interactive platforms for dissemination of information on traditional games.
- Support for publication of books and creation of educational content on indigenous games.

> **Promotion of Sports among Persons with Disabilities:**

- Specialized sports infrastructure for persons with disabilities.
- Equipment support and athlete classification assistance.
- Establishment of training centres for athletes with disabilities.
- Training and development of Indian classifiers.
- Support for coaching development programmes.
- Scholarships for coaching diploma courses.
- Support for national and international competitions, including Paralympic preparation.
- Development of coaching, sports science, and nutrition programmes for para-athletes.
- Creation of international-standard classification facilities.

> **Promotion of Sports among Women:**

- Financial assistance for women's sports competitions and leagues.
- Support for international and national-level women's competitions.
- Promotion of participation in sports with lower female representation.
- Awareness activities related to health, fitness, and sports participation.
- Scholarships for women pursuing sports coaching courses.
- Leadership development opportunities in coaching and sports administration.
- Gender sensitisation campaigns for athletes, coaches, and support staff.
- Workshops on safety, welfare, and legal protection of women athletes.
scheme.eligibility:
> **Sports for Peace and Development:**

- The organization/institution must be involved in organizing sporting activities in eligible States, Union Territories, or districts affected by terrorism, extremism, disturbances, or located along international land borders.
- The organization/institution must submit a proposal through the prescribed appraisal and approval mechanism under the scheme.

> **Promotion of Rural and Indigenous/Tribal Games:**

- The sports federation, sports association, stakeholder, or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) must be engaged in the promotion of rural, indigenous, or tribal games.
- The organization must submit proposals through the Sports Department of the concerned State or Union Territory for grants-in-aid.
- The organization must be involved in organizing competitions, promotional activities, training programmes, or development initiatives related to recognized indigenous games.

> **Promotion of Sports among Persons with Disabilities:**

- The State Government, Union Territory Administration, Sports Authority of India (SAI), recognized sports body, federation, or organization must be engaged in promoting sports among persons with disabilities.
- The organization must coordinate with recognized bodies such as the Para Olympics Committee of India (PCI), Special Olympics Bharat (SOB), All India Sports Council of Deaf (AISCD), or other relevant agencies, where applicable.
- The organization must submit proposals for infrastructure development, training programmes, competitions, coaching development, equipment support, athlete classification, or athlete preparation.

> **Promotion of Sports among Women:**

- The Indian Olympic Association (IOA), National Sports Federation (NSF), Government Agency, sports organization, or other stakeholder must be involved in promoting sports among women.
- The organization must submit proposals through the Sports Department of the concerned State or Union Territory for grants-in-aid, where applicable.
- The organization must organize competitions, leagues, awareness programmes, coaching initiatives, leadership development activities, or other programmes aimed at increasing women's participation in sports.

application_process.steps:
**Step 1:** The eligible organization identifies the relevant sub-component and proposed activity.
**Step 2:** The applicant prepares a detailed proposal as per the scheme guidelines.
**Step 3:** The proposal is submitted through the concerned Sports Department of the State or Union Territory, wherever applicable.
**Step 4:** The proposal is appraised by the Project Appraisal Committee (PAC).
**Step 5:** The proposal is placed before the Departmental Project Approval Committee (DPAC) for approval.
**Step 6:** Upon approval, financial assistance and support are released as per sanctioned activities.
**Step 7:** The implementing organization conducts the approved activities and utilizes funds according to scheme guidelines.

documents_required: Recommendation of State Sports Department (Where Applicable)
Details of Coaches and Technical Personnel (If Applicable)
Bank Account Details of Implementing Organization
Any Other Supporting Documents As Required.

faqs.question: What is the objective of this scheme-component?
faqs.answer: The component aims to promote social inclusion, gender equality, peace, development, and wider participation in sports among diverse sections of society.

faqs.question: What are the major sub-components under this component?
faqs.answer: The major sub-components are Sports for Peace and Development, Promotion of Rural and Indigenous/Tribal Games, Promotion of Sports among Persons with Disabilities, and Promotion of Sports among Women.

faqs.question: Who can receive support under Sports for Peace and Development?
faqs.answer: Eligible organizations and stakeholders conducting sports activities in disturbed, extremism-affected, or border areas can receive support.

faqs.question: What types of assistance are provided under Sports for Peace and Development?
faqs.answer: Support may include coaches, equipment, technical assistance, competitions, boarding, lodging, and travel-related expenses.

faqs.question: Which indigenous games are specifically mentioned for promotion?
faqs.answer: Mallakhamb, Kalaripayattu, Gatka, Thang-Ta, and Silambam are specifically mentioned for promotion.

faqs.question: Can Non-Governmental Organizations receive assistance under the indigenous games sub-component?
faqs.answer: Yes, eligible Non-Governmental Organizations involved in promoting rural and indigenous games may receive financial assistance.

faqs.question: Can talented indigenous game players receive additional support?
faqs.answer: Yes, talented players may be selected as Khelo India Athletes and provided support.

faqs.question: Which organizations are recognized for promoting sports among persons with disabilities?
faqs.answer: The Para Olympics Committee of India, Special Olympics Bharat, and All India Sports Council of Deaf are recognized organizations.

faqs.question: What support is available for athletes with disabilities?
faqs.answer: Support may include specialized infrastructure, equipment, training, athlete classification, coaching development, scholarships, and competition participation.

faqs.question: Are scholarships available under this component?
faqs.answer: Yes, scholarships may be provided for coaching diploma courses related to sports for persons with disabilities and women.

faqs.question: How does the component promote women's participation in sports?
faqs.answer: The component supports competitions, leagues, awareness programmes, coaching opportunities, leadership development, and gender sensitization initiatives.

faqs.question: Can women's competitions at national and international levels receive funding?
faqs.answer: Yes, national and international competitions for women may receive financial assistance under the component.

faqs.question: Who approves proposals submitted under this component?
faqs.answer: Proposals are appraised by the Project Appraisal Committee and approved by the Departmental Project Approval Committee.

faqs.question: Is there a fixed financial assistance amount under this component?
faqs.answer: No, the guidelines provide for appropriate budgetary support and financial assistance based on approved proposals and activities; no fixed monetary amount is specified.

scheme.name: Petrochemicals Research & Innovation Commendation
scheme.brief_description: The scheme aims to felicitate meritorious innovations in petrochemicals. It provides a citation, a memento, and Travel Allowance and Dearness Allowance for attending the ceremony to eligible Indian citizens, institutions, industries, and start-ups.
scheme.details: The scheme "Petrochemicals Research & Innovation Commendation" was launched by the Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers. The scheme aims to felicitate the meritorious innovations and inventions in the field of petrochemicals, products, processes and other areas of national and social importance. The scheme provides a citation and a memento to the awardees across various designated categories to incentivize sustainable development and innovation.
scheme.benefits:
- The scheme provides a citation and a memento for each award category.
- Travel Allowance and Dearness Allowance will be provided to the awardees for attending the presentation function in person.
- The scheme provides national and international recognition to innovations, helping to improve the performance and quality of products leading to better market acceptance.
- Historically, under the previous edition named National Petrochemicals Awards, a sum of ₹3,00,000/- each for winners and ₹1,00,000/- each for runners-up was awarded.
- The commendations shall be conferred annually.
scheme.eligibility:
- The applicant must be an Indian citizen, institution, industry, organisation, or Start-up registered in India.
- The applicant must be an entity created by the Central government, State governments, or Union Territories.
- The applicant must limit the maximum number of members to five, in case of applying as a team or group.
- The applicant must present an innovation that is an original product, process, or an improvement on an existing product or process.
- The applicant must ensure the innovation increases the utility of the product or process by enhancing consumer advantages, accuracy, reliability, safety, product life, or versatility.
- The applicant must not submit a mere theoretical hypothesis, an innovation simply in the idea stage, or a perpetual motion machine.
- The applicant must present an innovation that is not older than three years at the time of submitting the application.
- The applicant must not be an awardee of previous editions of the National Petrochemicals Awards for the immediate three preceding editions or years.

application_process.steps:
##### ***Step 1:*** ***Access the Official Portal for Application Submission***
The applicant must access the [official online portal](https://www.nationalpetrochemicalsawards.pds.gov.in) provided by the implementing agency, such as the Central Institutes of Petrochemicals Engineering and Technology, to find the scheme guidelines and application links.
##### ***Step 2:*** ***Fill out the Prescribed Application Format***
The applicant must apply online for the commendation under any relevant category or sub-category by selecting the appropriate form for an Individual, Team, Industry, Academic Institution, Research and Development Institution, or Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise.
##### ***Step 3:*** ***Provide Detailed Information and Documentation***
The applicant must fill in personal details, academic qualifications, organization details, and upload comprehensive write-ups, technical descriptions, test reports, and photographs substantiating the innovation.
##### ***Step 4:*** ***Submit the Complete Application Online***
The applicant must ensure that the application is complete in all respects, acknowledge the Certificate of Undertaking, and submit the application electronically for screening and evaluation by the designated screening committee.

##### ***CATEGORIES FOR THE COMMENDATIONS***
The commendations are divided into two major categories: 
***1. Research & Innovation in Polymers*** 

- Innovation in Polymeric Materials & Products 
- Innovation in Green Polymeric Materials & Products 
- Innovation in Packaging Techniques including creative Design 
- Innovation in Polymer Processing Machinery, Equipment’s, Robotics & Automation 
- Innovation in Polymer Waste Management 
- Innovation in Packaging Techniques including creative Design 
- Petrochemicals and Newer polymer Applications 
- Research in the field of Polymer Science & Technology (for Research Students of Academic Institute/Research lab) 
- Innovative “Start-up” venture in Polymer field 

***2. Application of Polymers in Various Fields*** 

- Polymers in Agriculture and Water Conservation 
- Polymers in Medical and Pharmaceutical Applications 
- Polymers in other fields

documents_required: Detailed Technical Description Giving Constructional and Working Mechanism along with Photographs
Write-Up on Originality or Novelty of Innovation
Write-Up on Advantages over Known Alternatives
Status of Publication or Patent in India and Abroad
Test Report to Substantiate Claims from Reputed Government Institute or Government Recognized National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories Test Agency
Status of Commercialization and Industrial Collaboration
Self-Appraisal by the Applicant Giving Full Justification for the Commendation
Particulars of Previous Awards Won by Applicant
Particulars of Business or Collaboration with Autonomous Bodies or Public Sector Undertakings of the Department
Action Plan for Next Three Years in Respect of Implementation or Commercialization of the Innovation
Certificate of Undertaking Signed by the Applicant and the Head of the Organization with a Seal

faqs.question: If I have developed a brilliant and highly detailed concept for a new polymeric material but haven't actually built a working model yet, can I submit my idea for consideration?
faqs.answer: Theoretical hypotheses and concepts that remain strictly in the idea phase are expressly prohibited. You must present an actionable product, process, or a tangible improvement, rather than just an untested theory.

faqs.question: Our university research lab wants to submit an application jointly, but our project involved a large number of researchers and faculty members. Is there any restriction on the size of the group applying?
faqs.answer: When applying collectively as a group or research unit, the maximum permissible size is rigidly restricted. You must ensure your submission includes no more than five participating members.

faqs.question: We successfully commercialized a revolutionary new polymer processing machinery design approximately four years ago, which is still highly popular today. Are we allowed to submit this established technology for the commendation?
faqs.answer: Submissions must focus on recent technological advancements. The product or process you are submitting cannot be older than three years at the time you formally submit your online application.

faqs.question: Our private limited enterprise wishes to secure the recognition officially under our corporate identity rather than attributing it to an individual employee. How should we correctly fill out the application details to reflect this?
faqs.answer: To ensure the accolade is granted to the corporate entity itself, you must explicitly list the organization's legal name within the designated primary applicant field on the submission form.

faqs.question: My manufacturing plant is known for its excellent human resources practices and low attrition rates, but we only commenced operations about two years ago. Do we qualify for the best employer recognition?
faqs.answer: Manufacturing industries or Research and Development units must demonstrate a minimum of three consecutive years in active operation to qualify for this specific evaluation track.

faqs.question: I am an independent researcher currently residing abroad and operating my own foreign-registered entity, though I frequently collaborate with Indian universities. Does my current residential and registration status align with the eligibility requirements?
faqs.answer: Submissions are strictly limited to Indian citizens, organizations, start-ups registered within India, or entities officially established by Central, State, or Union Territory authorities.

faqs.question: I was fortunate enough to be recognized and received an accolade during one of the previous annual events organized by the department. Will my past success prevent me from submitting a new application this year?
faqs.answer: Individuals or entities who secured a win in the immediate three preceding editions are disqualified from participating in the current cycle. You will be eligible again once that three-year restriction period concludes.

faqs.question: Does my submission necessarily have to be a completely newly invented material from scratch, or is it acceptable if I have simply enhanced the safety and lifespan of a currently available product?
faqs.answer: You do not need to invent something entirely new. Significant improvements made to existing products or processes that tangibly enhance safety, reliability, lifespan, or consumer advantages are perfectly acceptable.

faqs.question: I have developed several different innovative agricultural polymer products and packaging solutions over the past year. Is there a cap on how many distinct entries I can submit across the various available categories?
faqs.answer: Participants are restricted from submitting an unlimited number of entries. You are formally permitted to submit a maximum of two applications within each of the two major overarching categories.

faqs.question: We conduct extensive internal testing on all our new polymeric products and have comprehensive data proving our claims. Will our internal laboratory reports be sufficient to validate our submission?
faqs.answer: Internal validation is insufficient for the final evaluation process. You must substantiate your claims using formal test reports from a reputed Government Institute or an agency recognized by the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories.

faqs.question: We are a recently established company focusing entirely on importing high-quality polymer additives from Europe and selling them in the domestic market. Do we meet the criteria for the start-up venture category?
faqs.answer: This specific category targets new ventures producing innovative products, acting as import substitutes, or utilizing indigenous technologies. Mere importation and resale of foreign products does not align with these mandatory objectives.

faqs.question: Our Research and Development unit has been operating successfully for five years, but we currently maintain a very small, highly specialized core team consisting of only ten full-time staff members. Are we eligible for the workplace excellence category?
faqs.answer: To be considered for the employer-focused recognition, your organization or research unit must officially employ a minimum of twenty personnel actively on its payroll.

faqs.question: I have been working as a junior technician in a related industry for about five years and have made some minor improvements to our daily workflow. Could I potentially be considered for the lifetime achievement recognition?
faqs.answer: This specific honor is reserved exclusively for seasoned members who have demonstrated exceptional longevity in the field alongside a history of significant, outstanding contributions and major achievements.

faqs.question: I am currently pursuing my postgraduate studies and conducting experiments on original polymeric material processing in my university's laboratory. Is there a designated pathway for someone currently enrolled in an academic program to participate?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a dedicated classification specifically intended for individual or teams of research students operating within academic institutes and research laboratories who are developing prototypes for future industrial applications.

scheme.name: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons
scheme.ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
scheme.brief_description: The aims to provide shelter, protection, rehabilitation, livelihood opportunities, and social reintegration support to transgender persons. It also provides shelter facilities, food, medical care, counselling, legal assistance, skill development, and document support to transgender persons.
scheme.details:
The scheme "Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons" has been launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. It aims to provide shelter to destitute & abandoned Transgender persons with basic amenities like shelter, food, medical care and recreational facilities.
> **Objectives:**

- To provide shelter with basic amenities such as food, clothing, recreation, medical facilities and counselling.
- To safeguard the rights of Transgender persons.
- To confirm the prevalence of a congenial atmosphere in the Garima Greh by adopting uniform rules and regulations suitable for all Transgender persons.
- To empower a TG person through skill-development and skill-upgradation programmes to lead a decent and dignified life, and protect them from atrocities and social stigma.
scheme.benefits:
1. Provision of shelter for transgender persons facing social, psychological, and economic constraints.
1. Basic amenities, including food, medical care, and recreational facilities.
1. Legal care and psychological counselling for reintegration into families and society.
1. Capacity-building and skill-development training for livelihood enhancement and economic independence.
1. Assistance in obtaining Identity Cards, Permanent Account Number (PAN) Cards, Ration Cards, Passports, and other essential documents.
1. A safe, secure, and positive environment for the holistic development and rehabilitation of transgender persons.
scheme.eligibility:
> **The following are the eligibility criteria of Transgender Person as a resident of Garima Greh:**

- Transgenders certified issued through the National Portal for Transgender Persons, and preferably living below the poverty line. Persons having such a certificate from elsewhere may be persuaded to register on the National Portal.
- Transgenders who are abandoned, aged between 18 and 60 years
- Transgenders should not be engaged in sex work and beggary
- Transgenders must be unemployed and not engaged in productive commercial activities

> The person needs to register by filling in the admission form ([Annexure 2](https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/docs/GarimaGrehGuidleines.pdf)) and the personal affidavit as per the prescribed form [Annexure 3](https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/docs/GarimaGrehGuidleines.pdf) provided in the guidelines document.

application_process.steps: The Transgender person can visit the Garima Greh and register by filling out the admission form and the personal affidavit. The location of Garima Greh can be checked online - [https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/Applicant/Registration/ListofNGO.](https://transgender.dosje.gov.in/Applicant/Registration/ListofNGO)

documents_required: The Transgender certificate & identity card are nationally recognized and provided by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, the certificate is a mandatory document to avail the welfare measures being provided under the SMILE scheme.

The certificate can be obtained from the district magistrate’s office or from the block office. If the transgender person has undergone a sex change, then they will have to get a certificate from the hospital authorities.

faqs.question: Do I Get Any Monetary/Financial Assistance Under This Scheme?
faqs.answer: No

faqs.question: Do I Have To Pay For Staying In Garima Greh?
faqs.answer: No, It Is Free Of Cost.

faqs.question: Can I Apply Online?
faqs.answer: No. The application can be filled offline only

scheme.name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Program
scheme.brief_description: Begum Hazrat Mahal National scholarship is a scholarship scheme also known as Maulana Azad National scholarship scheme was first announced on 3rd May 2003. It is a national level scholarship started for the benefit of the girl’s student belonging to the minority communities.
scheme.details: The Scheme of “Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship” for Meritorious Girl Students belonging to the Minority Communities was earlier known as “Maulana Azad National Scholarship for Meritorious Girls belonging Minorities,” and the same was launched by the then Prime Minister of India (late) Atal Bihari Vajpayee at National Conference of Educational & Economic Development of Minorities held on 03.05.2003 at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
scheme.benefits: - **For Class IX & X:** ₹5,000/- each. - **For Class XI & XII:** ₹6,000/- each.
scheme.eligibility:
- Only girl students belonging to six notified Minority Communities i.e. Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains and Parsis are eligible.
 - The scholarship will be awarded to minority girl students who are studying in Class 9th to 12th and have secured at least 50% marks or equivalent grades in aggregate in the previous class/qualifying exam.
 - The annual income of the student’s parent/guardian from all sources does not exceed Rs.2.00 lakh.
 - An Income certificate, issued by a Competent Authority in the State/UTs Governments is required in respect of parent/guardian of the student.
 - A self-Certified Community Certificate is required from a student who has attained 18 years of age. For others, the Community Certificate certified by the parent/guardian of the student is required.
 - If a student violates school discipline or any other terms and conditions of the scholarship, the scholarship may be suspended or cancelled. The State Government/Union Territory Administration can also directly cancel the award if duly satisfied with the reasons of violation of these regulations governing the scheme.
 - If a student is found to have obtained a scholarship by false statement, her scholarship will be cancelled forthwith and the amount of the scholarship paid will be recovered by the concerned State/UT Govt.
 - The student obtaining benefits under this scheme shall not be allowed to avail of benefits under any other scheme for this purpose.
 - A student shall be eligible for only one scholarship out of all the available Scholarships of the Central Government meant for SC/ST/OBC/minority.
 - The scholarship will not be given to more than two students from a family of the same class
 - No scholarship shall be given for studies abroad for any course.

application_process.steps:
> **New Registration****:**

**Step 1:** Visit the [New Registration](https://scholarships.gov.in/otrapplication/#/) page of the National Scholarships Portal.
**Step 2:** Guidelines for Registration will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read the undertaking carefully and Accept the Terms. Click “Next”.
**Step 3:** In the next window, enter your mobile number and OTP. Then click “Verify”.
**Step 4:** After successful verification, continue with e-KYC process (as applicable).
**Step 5:** Once completed, your reference number will be generated and the same will be sent to your registered phone number.
> **Process for OTR ID Number Generation****:**

**Step 1:** Download and install [AadhaarFaceRD](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.uidai.facerd) services in the android device.
**Step 2:** Download and install the [NSP OTR](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.scholarships.nspotr&pli=1) App from the Google Play Store.
**Step 3:** After opening the mobile app Select the option “eKYC with FaceAuth” highlighted in red.
**Step 4:** Enter the allotted reference number and click on “Send OTP” to receive OTP on your mobile no. 
**Step 5:** Enter the received OTP and captcha in the screen and click Next.
**Step 6:** Click on “Proceed for Face Authentication” button highlighted in red.
**Step 7:** UIDAI AadhaarFaceRD services will be invoked for face authentication. Ensure AadhaarFaceRD services are preinstalled on your device.
**Step 8:** On Successful completion of face-authentication OTR no. will be generated and will also be sent on your registered mobile no.
> **Fresh Application****:**

**Step 1:** Visit the applicant [Login ](https://scholarships.gov.in/otrapplication/#/login-page)page of the National Scholarships Portal Enter your One Time Registration (OTR) number and password.
**Step 2:** Type the Captcha and click “Login”.
**Step 3:** On the next screen, provide the OTP received on your registered mobile number. You will be directed to the Password Reset screen. Create a new password and confirm.
**Step 4:** Click “Submit”. You will be directed to the “Applicant’s Dashboard”.
**Step 5:** On the left pane, click “Application Form”. The fields marked as * are compulsory. Fill in the details and upload the documents.
**Step 6:** You can either click on “Save as Draft” to complete the application later. Else, click “Final Submit” to submit the application.
> **Track Payment Status****:**

The student can track their payment status from the template “Know Your Payment” in the [Public Financial Management System (PFMS) Portal](https://pfms.nic.in/static/NewLayoutCommonContent.aspx?RequestPagename=static/TrackNSPpayments.aspx) either by indicating their Aadhaar Number, Bank Account number or NSP Application ID.
**NOTE 1:** The National Scholarships Portal will provide the timelines for opening & closing of the portal.
**NOTE 2:** Online applications will be verified at two levels i.e. by the Institute, where the student is studying and thereafter by the concerned State Higher Education Department or any other Agency/ Official nominated by the State as State Nodal Agency (both for fresh and renewal applicants).
**NOTE 3:** Students will not be permanently debarred for scholarships due to delay in renewal or verification. However, students will have to submit renewal applications within a cut-off date. Renewal for that year will not be allowed if an applicant misses this deadline.
> **Standard Operating Procedures:** [Click here](https://scholarships.gov.in/public/FAQ/NSP_SOP.pdf).

documents_required: Self declaration of the minority community.

faqs.question: Who are eligible to apply for Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Scheme (BHMNS) ?
faqs.answer: Only girl students belonging to six notified minority communities viz. Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi (Zoroastrian) studying in India and fulfilling the Scheme guidelines are eligible to apply for this scholarship.

faqs.question: How can I apply online for scholarship?
faqs.answer: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Scheme is online Scheme and one can apply for fresh Scholarship under this Scheme on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at www.scholarships.gov.in. Link to the Portal is also provided on the website of the Maulana Azad Education Foundation, i.e. www.maef.nic.in

faqs.question: Which fields I can edit before final submission of application?
faqs.answer: You can edit all details except "Registration Details". It may be noted that once you 'finally submit' your application it will be forwarded to the next level and after that you cannot edit further.

faqs.question: Which fields in the application form are mandatory?
faqs.answer: Fields provided with red asterisk(*) mark are mandatory fields.

faqs.question: Do I have to fill up the online application in one sitting?
faqs.answer:
No. You can fill up the online application in many sittings using 'Save Draft', until you are satisfied that you have entered all desirable fields correctly. The software provides facility to save your application at every stage until you
click on 'Submit' button

faqs.question: Is there any Application ID ?
faqs.answer: Yes. An Application ID will be provided to the candidate once her application is submitted online. It will be conveyed to candidates through SMS

faqs.question: What should I do if I forget my Application ID?
faqs.answer:
The process of re-collection of the Application ID is given as below:
"Student login-*>Forgot Registration Details?" then enter the basic fields accordingly and click on the button "Get Registration details.

faqs.question: How should I check the status of my application online?
faqs.answer: You have to login under the option 'Student Login' by entering your Application Id and Password. Once login, you will be able to view the option 'Check Your Status'. Under this option you can check your online status.

faqs.question: How do I know the name and address of Nodal Officer/ State Department of my State?
faqs.answer: The name and contact details of the Nodal Officer/State Department of all States/UTs are available under the link of Maulana Azad Education Foundation on the home page of National Scholarship Portal (NSP)(https://scholarships.gov.in/public/nodalOfficersList/BHMNS.pdf)

faqs.question: What should I do if I face some technical issue while applying for scholarship on NSP portal.
faqs.answer:
Ou can immediately register your complain through the link https://scholarships.gov.in/fresh/complaintspage or accessing Complaints -> Register Complaints on the home page of the NSP website or call on the Helpline
number 0120-6619540/23583788/89 or send mail on e-mail id: helpdesk@nsp.gov.in/scholarship-maef@nic.in

scheme.name: Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme
scheme.ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
scheme.department: Coconut Development Board
scheme.brief_description: The “Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS)” is being implemented by the Coconut Development Board, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India with the objective of insuring coconut palms against natural calamities, climatic risks, pests, diseases, and other perils.
scheme.details:
The “Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS)” is being implemented by the Coconut Development Board, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, with the objective of insuring coconut palms against natural calamities, climatic risks, pests, diseases, and other perils. Under this scheme, all healthy nut-bearing coconut palms in the age group of 4 years to 60 years in a contiguous area (mono/mixed) can be insured against natural perils leading to death/loss of palm/becoming unproductive. The scheme is being implemented in all coconut-growing States through Agriculture Insurance Company and implementing State Governments.
> **Objectives:**

 - Assist coconut growers in insuring coconut palms, against natural and other perils.
 - Provide timely relief to farmers, who suffer income loss due to sudden death of palms.
 - Minimize risk and encourage replanting and rejuvenation to make coconut farming remunerative.

> **Applicability:**

The CPIS will be applicable to all healthy nuts bearing coconut palms; grown as mono or intercropped; on bunds farms or homestead and to all varieties of coconut, including Tall, Dwarf and Hybrids. Since, Dwarf and Hybrids begin to yield fruit from 4th year of planting, this variety of coconut palms in age range of 4-60 year will be covered under the scheme, but Tall variety coconut palms will be eligible for coverage for age range of 7-60 year. Unhealthy and senile palms will be excluded from coverage. 
Risks covered: The scheme covers following perils leading to death/loss of palm or palm becoming un-productive:

 - Storm, hailstorm, cyclone typhoon, tornado, heavy rains.
 - Flood and inundation.
 - Pest and diseases of widespread nature causing, irreparable damages to palm.
 - Accidental fire, including forest fire and bush fire, lightening.
 - Earthquake, landslide and tsunami.
 - Severe drought and consequential total loss.

> **States & Areas Covered:**

 - This insurance scheme will be implemented in the selected districts of all the States/UTs, growing coconut palms.
 - All bearing and healthy palms will be insured, in a contiguous area, by farmer/grower and every effort will be made by CDB, to get all bearing and healthy palms insured, in cluster villages of district(s).
scheme.benefits:
**Sum Insured & Premium****:** Under this scheme, 50% of the premium is borne by the Board and balance is shared between the State Government and Farmers @ 25% each, as below:
Age group of PalmsPremium per plant/yearBoard’s Share (50%)State Govt. Share (25%) Farmer’s Share (25%) Sum insured per palm4-15 years ₹9₹4.50₹2.25₹2.25₹900/-16-60 years₹14₹7₹3.50₹3.50₹1750/-**Premium Subsidy:**

 - Of amount under above, 50% will be paid by Coconut Development Board (CDB) and 25% by State Government concerned and balance 25% will be paid by farmer/grower.
 - In case, the State government does not agrees to bear 25% share of premium, farmers/growers, will be required to pay 50% of premium, if interested in insurance scheme. In case some planters/growers’ association wishes to bear the premium on behalf of planters/growers, such associations may do so if they have ‘insurable interest’. 
 - In any case, the planters/ growers shall have to bear a minimum of 10% premium. Premium subsidy amount (50% by CDB and 25% by participating States) will be released to Insurance Company in advance based on estimates, which will be replenished / adjusted on quarter/year basis.

**Insurance Term:**

 - A policy can be issued for a maximum period of three years for which rebate in premium @7.5% for two year policy and 12.5% for three year policy will be provided to the planters/growers.
 - Effort will be made to ensure that all eligible farmers/growers join the scheme by 31st March of year. However, those farmers/growers who do not join the scheme by 31st March may join the scheme subsequently, and in which case risk is covered from 1st day of succeeding month.

**Contingency Insured:**
This insurance policy pays for total loss of palm on account of happening of perils insured leading to death of insured palm or It’s becoming unproductive. In case, death of palm is not immediate, payment of sum insured will be payable on production of certificate from Coconut Development Board (CDB)/Agriculture / Horticulture Department justifying cause for declaring palm unproductive. A palm can be declared ‘unproductive’ only when further growth / rejuvenation of palm is removed / possible after the same damaged by peril(s) insured, provided palm is removed / felled by insured. In case farmer / grower wishes to retain unproductive palm as it is (without felling), salvage value of 50% of sum insured will be deducted from claim. In any case, loss of palm will have to be established to, occurrence of peril insured.
scheme.exclusions:
No claims shall be payable under the scheme if the palm is lost due to operation of peril insured is within the ‘Franchise’ clause. Under this policy, the insurer will not be liable for any payment for any expenses incurred by the insured in connection with or in respect to loss other than on account of perils insured. The insurance does not cover the following events, in so far as they are applicable, keeping in view the scope of insurance coverage:

 - Loss by Theft, War, Invasion, Civil War. Rebellion, Revolution, Insurrection, Mutiny, Lockout, Malicious Damage, Conspiracy, Military/Usurped Power, Civil Commotion, Confiscation, Requisition/Destruction/damage by order of any Government de-jure/de-facto/by any public/municipal/local authority, including damage due to power transmission.
 - Nuclear reaction, nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
 - Impact damage due to aircraft or other falling objects
 - Wilful negligence of the insured and anyone acting on his behalf.
 - Damage caused by human, bird or any animal action.
 - Improper maintenance of palms.
 - Palm becoming unhealthy & senile.
 - Natural morality of the palm; uprooting of palm traceable to chiselling of roots.
